messages:
sasha_sales: Incoming RFI from Meridian Health they want an embeddings throughput table, static egress IP options, and a capability matrix showing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Can we pull together answers + an attachment by EOD Friday?
michael_se: Yep. I'll prep a compact rate table (per-embedding for small/medium/large models + per-1k-token gen). Will also add short notes on SLA and reserved-capacity pricing.
ritesh_eng: Network notes: for Private you can do VPC peering or PrivateLink. If customer wants fixed egress IPs we can publish stable CIDRs for Dedicated endpoints per-region. For customer-managed VPC the egress is their control but agents use these expected ranges for outbound calls. Also: model pre-pinning removes the need for outbound model fetches to S3.
sasha_sales: They explicitly asked for burst to 120 qps, sustained 40 qps, and embedding batch guidance. Add recommended batching and cache settings to the matrix please.
michael_se: Draft rates (include in RFI):
```
- Hosted embeddings (small): $0.00035 / embedding
- Hosted embeddings (med): $0.00055 / embedding
- Gen (hosted): $0.0010 / 1k tokens
- Dedicated: monthly reserved + 30-45% discount on per-unit rates for committed usage
- Private: enterprise license + optional ops SLA add-on
```
Recommend listing a sample POC configuration row with: batch_size=16, kv_cache=enabled, quant_profile=fp16->int8 for cost mode.
natalie_sec: Security bullets for customer doc: TLS 1.2+ enforced, mTLS available for Private endpoints, customer-managed KMS and BYO-HSM supported, SOC2 Type II + ISO27001, configurable retention and purge controls, export compliance addendum available. Q: do we want to call out pen-test windows?
ritesh_eng: Add note: if they require agent-to-control-plane mTLS, we can enable it for Private. Also include firewall/ports snippet: 443 outbound to control plane, optional inbound agent port when using an IP allowlist.
sasha_sales: Good. Can someone attach the matrix file here once ready? I'll assemble final package and send to Legal for a quick review before sending to the buyer.
deploy_bot: deploy-bot: Attachment uploaded: meridian_rfi_matrix_2026.xlsx (link: https://files.redwood/repo/ids/98765) :paperclip:
michael_se: Added a short note in the matrix about latency vs batch tradeoff: targeting 120 qps with batch=16 gives ~50ms median embed latency; batch=32 improves throughput but raises p99.
sasha_sales: Perfect. I'll pull this into the RFI template and ping legal + solutions eng for signoff. Thanks team :tada:
